portal_hypertension.title: Gun-sight technique for recanalization of chronic noncirrhotic, nonmalignant extrahepatic portal vein obstruction.
portal_hypertension.authors: Leite TFO, Nunes TF, Gonçalves B
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：由非肝硬化肝外门静脉血栓形成引起的门静脉高压是一种罕见的原因，与门静脉高压并发症相关的发病率和死亡率很高。 临床提示：门静脉再通是一种旨在恢复肝血流的技术，然而，其可行性可能受到闭塞复杂性的限制。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal hypertension resulting from thrombosis of the noncirrhotic extrahepatic portal vein is a rare cause with high morbidity and mortality related to complications of portal hypertension. Portal vein recanalization is a technique aimed at restoring hepatic blood flow, however, its viability may be limited by the complexity of the occlusion. This case report describes a portal vein recanalization using the gun-sight technique, which involves placing loops in the intrahepatic and extrahepatic portal veins to serve as targets for percutaneous needle advancement after failure of portal vein recanalization via conventional access. portal_hypertension.title: Limited association between liver stiffness and clinical outcomes in Fontan-associated liver disease: a retrospective analysis.
portal_hypertension.journal: International journal of cardiology. Congenital heart disease
portal_hypertension.authors: Cai L, Choudhary P, Tanous D
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：常规监测包括瞬时弹性成像 (TE) 和临床评估，但 Fontan 相关肝病 (FALD) 的纵向数据很少。 临床提示：Fontan 手术是针对单心室生理患者的姑息手术。
portal_hypertension.abstract: The Fontan procedure is a palliative operation for patients with univentricular physiology. Liver complications post-surgery are inevitable and include liver cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Routine surveillance includes transient elastography (TE) and clinical assessment, however longitudinal data on Fontan-associated liver disease (FALD) is scarce. This study aimed to describe the evolution of FALD and assess the correlation between liver stiffness measurement (LSM) and hepatic decompensation. This retrospective case series comprised all adult post-Fontan patients presenting to a tertiary hospital between January 2015 and December 2024. Demographic and clinical information, se...

portal_hypertension.title: Clinical Outcomes of Terlipressin Using Continuous Infusion Versus Bolus in Patients With Acute Variceal Hemorrhage-A Randomized Controlled Trial.
portal_hypertension.studyType: Journal Article / Randomized Controlled Trial / Comparative Study
portal_hypertension.authors: Abid S, Butt N, Qasim C
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：比较特利加压素连续输注与推注输注治疗急性静脉曲张出血的临床结果。 临床提示：特利加压素常用于治疗急性静脉曲张出血，但关于最佳给药方法（连续输注与间歇推注）的证据有限。
portal_hypertension.abstract: To compare clinical outcomes of terlipressin as continuous versus bolus infusion for the management of acute variceal hemorrhage. Terlipressin is commonly used in the management of acute variceal bleeding, but evidence on the optimal method of administration-continuous infusion versus intermittent bolus-is limited. Patients presented with acute variceal bleeding were randomized into 2 arms: the intervention arm and the control arm received continuous and bolus infusion of terlipressin, respectively. portal_hypertension.title: Model-informed dose optimization of carvedilol and nebivolol in cirrhotic patients: a pilot randomized clinical study.
portal_hypertension.authors: Tarek M, Ali AA, Biomy R
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 44）。核心观点：在门静脉高压和动脉高压存在的情况下，肝硬化会导致生理和药代动力学改变，使抗高血压治疗变得复杂。 临床提示：本研究评估了 PBPK 指导下的卡维地洛和奈必洛尔给药方案对肝硬化患者的疗效和安全性。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Liver cirrhosis causes physiological and pharmacokinetic alterations that complicate antihypertensive therapy, in the presence of portal and arterial hypertension. This study evaluated the efficacy and safety of PBPK-guided dosing of carvedilol and nebivolol in cirrhotic patients. First, PBPK models were validated using clinical pharmacokinetic data from healthy volunteers and optimized for cirrhosis, then applied to simulate untested cirrhotic populations and estimate unbound plasma exposure across disease stages. portal_hypertension.title: Characterization of liver disease regression in murine models of liver fibrosis and portal hypertension.

portal_hypertension.abstract: Characterization of toxin-induced mouse models of regressive liver disease, focusing on the detecting of a suitable therapeutic window during fibrosis and portal hypertension (PH) regression. C57BL/6JRj mice were studied when exposed to thioacetamide (TAA) or carbon tetrachloride (CCl 4 ) for 8 or 12 weeks (8w/12w) and after one/two (+R1/+R2) week(s) of TAA/CCl 4 -free regression. Healthy controls received NaCl or olive oil (OO). Primary readouts included liver fibrosis (collagen proportionate area, CPA), portal pressure (PP), serum transaminases and hepatic fibrosis-related gene expression.
